chunks: When all men are gathered together (on that Day) they will become their enemies and deny their worship.
ai.seo_question: What happens to people's relationships and faith on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate futility of idolatry and false deities, as worshippers will disown their idols on the Day of Judgment, realizing they were merely led astray. It underscores the concept of 'Kufr' not just as disbelief, but as a rejection of the truth of one's own worship, marking a complete severance between the devotee and the deviated object of their reverence. This serves as a warning against blind following (Taqlid) of false guides who will deny their followers when accountability arrives.
